description: The pie chart presents the distribution of relation categories used in the MMRA benchmark for evaluating multi-granularity and multi-image relational association capabilities in large visual language models, and it contains 11 slices. The slices are labeled with counts and percentages: an unlabeled mint/teal slice at 126 (12.28%); SimilarMaterial in orange at 106 (10.33%); SubEvent in red at 100 (9.74%); UsageSimilarity in salmon/orange-red at 100 (9.65%); Environment in dark teal at 90 (8.77%); Layout in pale yellow at 90 (8.77%); AppearanceSimilarity in light green at 90 (8.77%); SimilarEvent in light blue at 90 (8.77%); MentalitySimilarity in light cyan at 89 (8.67%); RelativePosition in light gray at 81 (7.90%); and NearSameEntity in dark gray at 63 (6.34%). The chart uses direct text labels with percentages around the pie (no separate legend is shown), and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the segments appear arranged roughly from larger values on the left/top-left toward smaller values near the top.
